name: looks-viewer
title: Looks viewer
description: A looks@1 artifact kind for *.looks.json: the same *.mockup.html key screen in 2 to 6 shadcn themes side by side (label, one-line personality, colour, font and radius swatches, Pick), then layout variants in the chosen look. A look is a shadcn preset and its theme block, applied to each sandboxed frame through MockupViewer's themeOverride. The host decides what a pick does.
